summary.text: Jeff Van Drew is the incumbent U.S. Representative for New Jersey's 2nd District. A dentist by training, he held local office in Dennis Township and Cape May County and served in the New Jersey Legislature before his 2018 election to Congress as a Democrat; he announced in December 2019 that he was switching to the Republican Party. He serves on the House Judiciary and Transportation and Infrastructure Committees.

paragraphs.text: Born in New York City on February 23, 1953.
Earned a B.S. from Rutgers University and, according to his House biography, a D.M.D. degree from Fairleigh Dickinson University.
Worked as a dentist; his House biography says he owned and operated a dental practice in South Jersey for 30 years. Wikipedia reports he has served as president of the New Jersey Dental Society.

Held local offices in Cape May County, including Dennis Township fire commissioner (1983-1986), township committee member (1991), and Cape May County freeholder (1994-1997 and 2000-2002), according to Wikipedia.
Served as mayor of Dennis Township (1994-1995 and 1997-2003).
Served in the New Jersey General Assembly (2002-2007) and the New Jersey State Senate (2008-2019); his House biography counts three Assembly terms and four Senate terms.
Won the open 2nd District seat in November 2018 as a Democrat, defeating Republican Seth Grossman 52.9% to 45.2% after Rep. Frank LoBiondo announced his retirement.

Announced on December 19, 2019 that he was switching from the Democratic to the Republican Party, a day after voting against both articles of impeachment against President Trump. He was re-elected in 2020, 2022 and 2024; his House biography describes the 2024 win as his fourth term.
Serves on the House Judiciary Committee and the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee.
According to his House biography, he and his wife have two children and two grandchildren and live in Dennis Township.
